Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
This situation came up last night, but I thought I'd confirm our
"ruling" here anyway:

Player has Information Highway and Marcus Vitel uncontrolled with 9
blood. Merged Marcus is also in his crypt.

Can he influence out Marcus with 1 transfer and then merge him with 1
more blood and 4 transfers?

We decided he could not because...
"At the end of your influence phase, any vampire in your uncontrolled
region with a number of blood counters on him equal to (or more than)
his capacity becomes controlled."

His influence phase was over so there were no more opportunities to
transfer. Sound right?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jeff Kuta wrote:
> This situation came up last night, but I thought I'd confirm our
> "ruling" here anyway:
>
> Player has Information Highway and Marcus Vitel uncontrolled with 9
> blood. Merged Marcus is also in his crypt.

"Merged" is not a trait that can be applied to a card in the crypt (or
ash heap).

You mean "Advanced Marcus is also in his crypt".

> Can he influence out Marcus with 1 transfer and then merge him with 1
> more blood and 4 transfers?

Or, more probably, you meant "Advanced Marcus is also in his uncontrolled
region".

> We decided he could not because...
> "At the end of your influence phase, any vampire in your uncontrolled
> region with a number of blood counters on him equal to (or more than)
> his capacity becomes controlled."
>
> His influence phase was over so there were no more opportunities to
> transfer. Sound right?

Correct.
